sourceFile: 03. BRS-161016 Report  check and improve NG separate VP+CD-04.2025_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft conflates several independent VP+CD improvement trials into one changed factor, so it is not valid final evidence.
issues: Changed factor mixes LED UV dose, bond type, VP bending sorting, jig repair, and temperature context.
Baseline and test conditions are inconsistent, mixing Normal and Old bond across different dates and sheets.
Outcomes from separate reports and test rounds are grouped under one factor without preserving sheet/date context.
Some measurement candidates wrongly include defect-count rows as tension or LED UV statistics.
Review title and purpose reflect only the first sheet, not all grouped evidence.
correctionPlan: Split into separate review cases or factors by report sheet/test round and primary changed condition.
Define baseline and test condition per comparable table only.
Keep date, line, round, bond type, UV setting, jig status, and temperature as grouping keys.
Remove or reclassify extracted measurement stats that come from defect/function rows.
Cite purpose/content rows plus matching result rows for each corrected factor.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations mostly exist, but they are insufficient because grouping and comparability are invalid.
